messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty - Incident #PD-48321 fired: p99 latency > 1200ms for route /v1/generate (eu-west-1). 5m window. link: https://ops.redwood.ai/alerts/PD-48321
jen: Acked. I'm on call. Checking dashboards + recent deploys.
omar: Ack - oncall. Seeing big tail on p95->p99, CPU on a few pods spiking. No new deploys in last 40m.
ryan: Confirm no deploys, canary finished ~30m ago. No infra changes.
lucy: Telemetry: KV cache eviction rate jumped ~18x at ~1725303960. Hotkey behaviour on customer-acme sessions looks correlated.
jen: wdyt about throttling that key or routing ACME to dedicated pool?
omar: I'll try a quick routing change to fallback model variant to reduce compute per request.
pd-bot: PagerDuty - Alert unacked > 90s, escalating to SRE Lead (ryan).
ryan: Got it. Assigning to oncall team. Is there an automated fallback we can flip?
jen: We have a routing policy flag. Short command to reroute eu-west traffic for /v1/generate to model:stable-quantized (lower perf but much lower GPU memory).
jen: ```
redwoodctl route update --region eu-west-1 --route "/v1/generate" \
  --model stable-quantized --weight 100
```
omar: Executing now. Pushing 100% to stable-quantized in eu-west. Watching KPIs.
lucy: Note: doing that will increase latency for embeddings callers but should lower burst OOMs and reduce p99.
jen: Also scaling dedicated pool: from 3 -> 6 gpus for eu-west burst capacity. ```
redwoodctl pool scale --pool inference-eu-west --replicas 6
```
pd-bot: PagerDuty - Acknowledgement recorded (jen).
omar: Route change applied at 1725304025. Scaling started.
ryan: Any quick mitigation window for customers? Should we open a status page?
lucy: Impact calc: 3 customers saw sustained p99 increase; estimated user request slowdown for ~2.1% of total traffic. No increased error budget breaches yet but SLO burn is high. Recommend status note referencing degraded latency for /v1/generate in eu-west.
jen: I'll draft status page blurb and internal bulletin.
jen: Observability: p99 has dropped from ~1250ms -> ~380ms in last 60s since route switch; p95 back to normal.
omar: Scaling finished at 1725304100. No OOMs on sidecars. KV eviction rate trending down after heuristics kicked in.
ryan: Great. Keep monitoring 10m window. If stable, we'll keep fallback for 30m and then gradually roll back.
jen: Leaving rollout strategy: keep model stable-quantized for 30m, then 50/50 for 10m, then revert if p99 < 450ms.
lucy: Logging note: recorded incident tag PD-48321, customer-impact=true, mitigation=routing+scale.
pd-bot: PagerDuty - Incident acknowledged by jen at 1725304010.
jen: Thanks team. I'll update the status page and post a post-incident summary after we confirm metrics.
incident-bot: PagerDuty - Incident PD-48321 resolved (auto-resolve) at 1725304123.
jen: Closing thread, will file postmortem with timeline + suggested hotkey protection rule. :thumbsup:
